title: Lowering Speed Limit for Bicycles on Shared Paths to Enhance Safety
what_it_is: Lowering Speed Limit for Bicycles on Shared Paths to Enhance Safety

sections.label: Speed limit on shared paths
sections.summary: The 25 kilometres per hour speed limit for bicycles and other active mobility devices on shared paths is based on normal cycling speed and considers shared use and safety.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The speed limit of 25 kilometres per hour for bicycles as well as other active mobility devices on shared paths is based on normal cycling speed and takes into account the rules of shared used and the safety of all users.

sections.label: Lower speed limit on footpaths
sections.summary: On narrower paths called footpaths, the speed limit has been lowered to 10 kilometres an hour.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In areas where the paths are narrower – those are what we call footpaths – the speed limit has been lowered to 10 kilometres an hour.

sections.label: Monitoring and revising speed rules
sections.summary: The paths are for people with mobility issues, and the situation will be observed and monitored, with rules on speeds revised where necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: That means, these are for people with mobility issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We will continue to observe, monitor the situation; and where necessary, we could look at revising the rules on the speeds.

sections.label: Public education campaigns since 2016
sections.summary: LTA has rolled out public education campaigns since 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: LTA has rolled out public education campaigns since 2016.

sections.label: No cycling paths on roads
sections.summary: Due to space constraints, especially on road infrastructure, cycling paths are not built on roads.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Due to the space constraints, especially on road infrastructure, we do not build cycling paths on roads.

sections.label: Separate paths or shared paths
sections.summary: Where possible, cycling paths and pedestrian-only paths are separated, and when space is more limited, shared paths are used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: As I said earlier, where it is possible, we will separate the cycling paths and pedestrian-only paths.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: When the space is more limited, then we will have shared paths.

sections.label: Enforcement against errant users
sections.summary: Enforcement will be carried out and errant users taken to task for unsafe behaviours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: At the same time, we will carry out enforcement and take errant users to task for unsafe behaviours.
